input.short_description: Install and use the Godzilla Go SDK to manage pipelines and connectors from Go.
input.body:
Go SDK {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}}

A typed client for the v2 REST API for Go 1.18+.

Install

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=go get github.com/godzilla-ai/go-sdk}}

Create a client

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=package main import ( "context" "os" "github.com/godzilla-ai/go-sdk" ) func main() { client := sdk.NewClient(sdk.WithAPIKey(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY"))) _ = client }}}

Create a pipeline

Maps directly onto the Pipelines endpoint — see the Building your first pipeline guide for the concepts.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=ctx := context.Background() pipeline, err := client.Pipelines.Create(ctx, &sdk.CreatePipelineRequest{ Name: "ingest-orders", SourceConnectorID: "conn_pg_orders", DestinationConnectorID: "conn_snowflake_dw", }) if err != nil { panic(err) }}}

Error handling & retries

Wraps error handling as described in Handling errors & retries:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=ctx := context.Background() err := client.Events.Replay(ctx, "evt_8f2c1a90") if err != nil { switch err.(type) { case *sdk.NotFoundError: // Event not found case *sdk.RateLimitError: // Rate limited; retry with backoff default: // Handle other errors } }}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Context support|body_html=

All methods accept a context.Context for timeout and cancellation control, making it easy to integrate with Go servers and workers.

}}
